lifetimeEvidence.criterion: Government explicitly identifies 1278 as the Principality's birth; the French co-prince supplies the day. The earlier episcopal lordship is recorded in 1133. Later pareage, French co-lord relations and the 1993 constitution do not automatically restart the polity.
